Update as of 12/08/2023
Added Spawn Protections (not point protections).
Re-did the overhead.
Some custom fixes/nerfs.
Music off command is now a button.
Per default you spawn with your own character.
If in TJO group you spawn Jedi instead of waiting til it loads to change teams / character.

Increased repulse cooldown to prevent spam, aside from other minor change of balances.
Added a low level zone near D, planned to add more in the future.
Updated a bit the admin.
